messages:
omar_fin: flagging an invoice dispute from Northpoint Labs (private deployment) 126. customer says the "true-up usage" line looks like double-billed GPU hours during their Dedicated burst in Oct. invoice INV-2027-0105-112 attached.

mike_billing: can you paste the line items? I'll pull the usage ledger.

omar_fin: copied from PDF: 

1 x Dedicated Reserved Capacity (annual)  120,000.00
Platform Fee (annual)  15,000.00
True-up - GPU Hours (Oct 2026)  18,750.00
True-up - GPU Hours (Oct 2026)  18,750.00
Support - Standard (monthly)  2,100.00
Total  174,700.00

customer says they only used ~1500 hours not 3000.

tara_csm: we ran the burst in two waves during Oct for a migration test. infra logged two separate bursts but billing should have consolidated usage; customer expects single aggregated true-up.

mike_billing: ledger shows two usage batches: USAGE-BATCH-1025 (1,500h) and USAGE-BATCH-1030 (1,500h). our pricing rule for Dedicated had a post-process that aggregates same-day batches but not across multiple calendar chunks; it's splitting into per-batch true-ups. looks like a product/price rule gap.

eric_fpna: we need to avoid irritating customers. Options: 1) issue a single credit to remove duplicate/aggregation mis-bill = $18,750 (one duplicate line) and update billing rule; 2) re-run billing calculation and issue corrected invoice (messy for AR). Preference is credit memo. what's the final duplicate amount?

mike_billing: duplicate = one of the two True-up lines = $18,750. That is > $10k so Sophie approval required. Also we must consider if platform fee proration applies because migration spanned billing cycle. customer mentioned platform fee appeared full, but they expect pro-rated reduction because they terminated part of committed capacity on 2026-10-28.

omar_fin: right 126: customer reduced committed nodes on 2026-10-28 and our system didn't prorate platform fee for the remaining term. They only requested a temporary burst then reduced baseline.

sophie_finance: summarize requested corrections: 1) remove duplicate true-up line ($18,750) 2) evaluate platform fee proration from 2026-10-28 to contract year end and credit pro-rated amount if applicable. Need GL impact and approval thresholds.

eric_fpna: combined potential credit could be ~ $18,750 + prorated platform fee. What's the platform proration delta?

mike_billing: Platform fee annual $15,000. Prorate reduction for remainder of term (Nov 1 2026 - Oct 31 2027) if they reduced committed capacity by 25% that would reduce platform fee by $3,750 annually; but customer requested mid-cycle effective 2026-10-28 so first adjustment is 12/365 * $3,750 = ~$123. we'll compute exact days. total estimated credit ~ $18,873 which still > $10k so Sophie sign-off required.

sophie_finance: approve issuing credit memo once amounts are exact. two requirements: 1) include note "duplicate true-up consolidation & platform proration due to committed capacity reduction 2026-10-28" 2) require sales sign-off that customer agreed to capacity reduction terms (attach amendment). @neil_sales please confirm amendment exists.

neil_sales: confirmed amendment NPL-2026-AMD-07 signed 2026-10-29 (effective 2026-10-28). I'll attach signed doc to the account. customer already emailed acceptance.

mike_billing: I will run precise proration calculation and produce CreditMemo-CM-2027-0106-901 for the combined amount and queue for posting. Draft ETA 1 hour. Will also create internal ticket to change billing rule to aggregate true-up across bursts within a rolling 7-day window for Dedicated to avoid double lines.

billing-bot: Draft Credit Memo CM-2027-0106-901 generated for Northpoint Labs  18,873.50 (draft). PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2027-0106-901-draft.pdf

tara_csm: I'll let the customer know we are crediting and will confirm when the credit posts. thanks for moving quickly.

eric_fpna: note for month close: allocate credit to deferred revenue for true-ups and platform fee adjustments under journal JNL-2027-01-REV. I'll coordinate final posting with Billing.

sophie_finance: approved. please include rationale and amendment link on the credit memo. once posted, notify AR to proceed with net payment.

mike_billing: Credit Memo CM-2027-0106-901 posted and applied to INV-2027-0105-112. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2027-0106-901.pdf

billing-bot: Account balance updated. Net invoice now $155,826.50. Payment pending.

neil_sales: customer replied "Thanks for the quick fix 126. We'll process payment and file the amendment."

omar_fin: closing ask: can we add a billing QA step for Dedicated burst consolidations in the migration checklist? cc @mike_billing.

mike_billing: will make a small enhancement ticket and schedule with product. closing thread.
